name: more-icons
author: lumine-code
description: Show file-type icons in the tree view, tabs, and search results.

set.title: Icon set
set.description: `file-icons` carries roughly 900 hand-curated glyphs with per-language colours. `seti` is the icon set Visual Studio Code ships by default.

enum.description: Seti - the Visual Studio Code default

customThemePath.title: Custom theme folder
customThemePath.description: *Only the `seti` set*. Absolute path to a folder holding a `*-icon-theme.json` in the Visual Studio Code file-icon-theme format, plus the fonts it references. Leave empty to use the bundled Seti theme. Themes whose icons are SVG rather than glyphs are not supported.

coloured.title: Colour the icons
coloured.description: Untick to render every icon in the theme's own text colour.
